2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Kochetkov led the Hurricanes onto the ice for warmups.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hurricanes Head Coach Rod Brind'Amour has rotated goalies almost evenly in recent seasons, but Pyotr Kochetkov's outstanding early-season performances have led him to deviate from the plan. The 27-year-old goalie returns to the crease on Thursday for his ninth start in Carolina's last 12 games and, deservedly, after posting a tremendous undefeated 8-0-0 record with an absurd 1.62 GAA and .918 SV%. In his previous outing, he saved 15 of 16 shots (.938 SV%) in a 2-1 win over the Boston Bruins. The Hurricanes enter Thursday's contest as significant -253 home favourites against a Columbus Blue Jackets team that has scored two or fewer goals in four of their last five games (3-2-0).
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Greaves will start in Carolina on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Greaves has had an up-and-down start to the 2026-27 season, paving the way for more starts for Cam Talbot in recent games, but he will return to the crease on Thursday. The 25-year-old Greaves had a 31-save shutout last week in a 1-0 overtime win over the New York Rangers, which he followed up by allowing five goals on 19 shots (.737 SV%) in a 6-2 loss to the Toronto Maple Leafs. He has a pedestrian 3.34 GAA and .883 SV% in six games (2-3-0). The Blue Jackets enter Thursday's game as sizeable +220 road underdogs against a Carolina Hurricanes team that is 3-0-1 in their last four games.

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Silovs will start vs. Utah on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: In eight games this season, Silovs has already posted two shutouts, the first of his career, but he's been wildly inconsistent. The 25-year-old Latvian goalie has allowed two or fewer goals in four games but five in the other four. Silovs has a 2.87 GAA and .890 SV% in eight games (5-3-0). The Penguins enter Thursday's action as +116 home underdogs against a Utah Mammoth team that defeated them 5-4 less than two weeks ago.
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Cossa led the Mammoth onto the ice for warmups.

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Vasilevskiy will start vs. Winnipeg on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Vasilevskiy boasts a 5-3-0 record through eight games, but hasn't lived up to the standard he set last season when he won his second Vezina Trophy. The 32-year-old Russian goalie allowed five goals on 23 shots (.783 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 6-3 loss to the Colorado Avalanche. He has uncharacteristically allowed three or more goals in five of eight games this season, posting a pedestrian 2.78 GAA and .884 SV%. Still, Tampa Bay enters Thursday's game as sizeable -228 home favourites against a struggling Winnipeg Jets team that has scored two or fewer goals in five straight games (0-4-1).
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Skinner will start in Tampa Bay on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Impressive early-season performances from Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson made Connor Hellebuyck's suspension (and eventual trade) an afterthought, but recent struggles have become overpowering. Skinner has lost three straight (0-2-1), but has remained serviceable, posting a 2.30 GAA and .920 SV%. He has a 2.60 GAA and .911 SV% in eight games (3-2-3). The Jets enter Thursday's game as significant +203 road underdogs against a Tampa Bay Lightning team on a two-game losing streak (0-1-1).

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Gibson will start Thursday vs. the Blackhawks.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Gibson had a tremendous inaugural season with the Red Wings in 2025-26, nearly leading them to a postseason berth, but 2026-27 has started rocky for the team, including Gibson. The 33-year-old American goalie struggled in his previous outing, allowing four goals on 25 shots (.840 SV%) in a 4-1 loss to the Calgary Flames. Gibson has an ugly 3.44 GAA and .867 SV% in eight games this season (3-4-1). The Red Wings enter Thursday's outing as -161 home favourites against a Chicago Blackhawks team that has scored two or fewer goals in four straight games (1-3-0).
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Knight led the Blackhawks onto the ice for warmups.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Knight was excellent in his previous game, saving 25 of 26 shots (.962 SV%) in a 2-1 win over the Los Angeles Kings. The 25-year-old American goalie has had an up-and-down season, posting a subpar 3.23 GAA and .897 SV% in 10 games (4-6-0), but he's been more reliable lately, allowing three or fewer goals in five of his last six (3-3-0) and saving 163 of 180 shots (.906 SV%). The Blackhawks enter Thursday's contest as +136 road underdogs against a Detroit Red Wings team with points in six straight games (5-0-1).

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Saros will start vs. Washington on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Saros has had consecutive disappointing seasons, finishing with sub- .900 SV% for the first two times in his career, but is off to an encouraging start in 2026-27. Despite a modest 3-2-3 record, Saros has been serviceable with a 2.81 GAA and .906 SV% in nine games (3-2-4). He saved 24 of 27 shots (.889 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 4-3 shootout loss to the New York Islanders. The Predators enter Thursday's action as slight -100 home underdogs against a Washington Capitals team that defeated the Philadelphia Flyers 5-2 last night.
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Lindgren will start Thursday in Nashville.

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Wallstedt will start vs. the Islanders on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Wallstedt has been busy with Filip Gustavsson (hip) sidelined and will return to the crease for the 13th time in Minnesota's first 15 games. The 23-year-old Swedish goalie has given Head Coach John Hynes no reason to deviate, posting an impressive 1.99 GAA and .922 SV% in 12 outings (8-2-2). He saved 26 of 27 shots (.963 SV%) in his most recent game, a 3-1 win over the Utah Mammoth. Minnesota enters Thursday's contest as -171 home favourites over the New York Islanders.
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Sorokin will start in Minnesota on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Sorokin has been reliable most nights this season, but is coming off a poor outing in his most recent game, allowing a season-high six goals on 38 shots (.842 SV%) in a 6-3 loss to the Dallas Stars. That said, the 31-year-old Russian goalie still boasts a solid 2.26 GAA and .919 SV% through eight games this season (5-3-0). The Islanders enter Thursday's outing as +167 road underdogs against the Central Division-leading Minnesota Wild, who are on a three-game winning streak.

2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: The Bruins lead the Atlantic Division with a 9-3-1 record, largely thanks to Jeremy Swayman's stellar play. Swayman has a 2.19 GAA and .921 SV% in 10 games this season (7-2-1). The Bruins enter Thursday's contest as slight -103 road underdogs against a St. Louis Blues team that has been shut out in consecutive games (0-2-0).

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Oettinger will start vs. Montreal on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Casey DeSmith saw the Stars' five-game winning streak snap in their previous game, a 5-1 loss to the New Jersey Devils. Oettinger has been tremendous to start the season and will return to the crease on Thursday. The 27-year-old American goalie has won four straight, posting a solid 1.70 GAA and .909 SV%. He has a 1.43 GAA, a .929 SV%, and three shutouts in nine games this season (6-2-1). The Stars enter Thursday's game as -165 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team with points in five straight games (4-0-1).
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Dobes will start in Dallas on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a breakout 2025-26 season that continued with an impressive postseason run, Dobes has struggled early in 2026-27. As a result, the Canadiens have often turned to Jacob Fowler, who has dazzled when called upon, posting an absurd 1.54 GAA and .942 SV% in seven games (6-1-0). That said, after Fowler's sensational 46-save shutout in Montreal's previous game, the team will turn to Dobes on Thursday. The 25-year-old Dobes has played only once in the past two weeks, in a 4-3 overtime loss to the San Jose Sharks, where he allowed four goals on 30 shots (.867 SV%).

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Kuemper will start vs. Ottawa on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Kuemper had a forgettable season debut, allowing eight goals on 29 shots (.724 SV%) in an 8-4 loss to the Colorado Avalanche, but has been solid since. The 36-year-old veteran goalie has won three straight games, posting a 2.26 GAA and .931 SV%. Still, the Kings enter Thursday's game as slight +105 home underdogs against an Ottawa Senators team that has lost three of their last five games (2-3-0).
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Johansson will start in Los Angeles on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: With Linus Ullmark (lower body) expected to miss another week, the Senators will continue to roll with Samuel Ersson and Jonas Johansson, turning to Johansson on Thursday against the Los Angeles Kings. The 31-year-old Johansson was solid in Ottawa's previous game, saving 25 of 27 shots (.926 SV%) in a 4-1 loss to the Vegas Golden Knights. The Senators enter Thursday's game as -116 road favourites against a low-scoring Kings team that scored fewer than two goals in six of their last nine games (3-5-1).

2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Ellis is in the starter's crease at Buffalo's morning skate.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: With Alex Lyon (upper body) still out this season, the Sabres have leaned heavily on Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, but they will turn to Ellis for back-to-back starts on Thursday. The 26-year-old Ellis earned another start after a tremendous performance in Buffalo's previous game, stopping all 23 shots in a 2-0 shutout win over the San Jose Sharks. The Sabres enter Thursday's action as -131 road favourites against a struggling Anaheim Ducks team that has lost six of their last seven games (1-5-1).

2026-10-29.homeNewsDetails: Askarov will start vs. Vancouver on Thursday.
2026-10-29.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Askarov started the season with a dreadful 4.00 GAA and .848 SV% in his first five games (2-3-0), but has turned things around in recent outings. Despite a 1-2-0 record, Askarov has been stellar in his last three games, allowing two or fewer goals in each and saving 109 of 114 combined shots (.956 SV%). The Sharks enter Thursday's game as -165 home favourites against a Vancouver Canucks team coming off an impressive come-from-behind 6-5 overtime win over the Anaheim Ducks.
2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Merilainen will start in San Jose on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Leevi Merilainen has struggled in recent games, but he will return to the crease for a third straight outing, an unfortunate testament to his counterpart, Kevin Lankinen's abysmal play. The 24-year-old Merilainen remains the preferred choice in Vancouver's crease, despite allowing 14 goals on 100 shots (.860 SV%) in his past three games (1-2-0). Merilainen has a 3.35 GAA and a .900 SV% in nine appearances this season (2-3-1). The Canucks enter Thursday's outing as +148 road underdogs against a San Jose Sharks team coming off a 2-0 loss to the Buffalo Sabres.
